summary: Iter76 stability review. Ran 14 backend pytest tests (all pass) + full frontend smoke via Playwright as super_admin. Store ranking, 90-day insights (leaderboard/top-sellers/trending/summary), proxy-health, /api/stores hygiene, POST /api/stores rejection of *.example.com, and my-products all verified. Frontend: My Products renders 2233 products with matching my_price on row and detail panel (no double-VAT), Product Detail panel opens with seller list + price history, Market Strength Ranking shows all 4 stores with revenue/tier labels ('Accumulating' / 'Not measurable (Salla)'), Insights + Discounts + Stores pages render with no NaN/undefined/[object Object].

issues: Console warning: Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby (a11y warning, non-blocking)

action_items: Optional a11y polish: add aria-describedby or DialogDescription to the product detail Radix DialogContent to silence console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large (>10k lines) — consider splitting into modules (routers, services, sales rollups, ranking) for maintainability.
_sales_pairs_from_rollups fix is correct (defensive .get). Consider adding a schema-level default at write-time on sku_sales_daily so downstream consumers never need per-field .get fallbacks.
store_registry.ensure_stores now deletes *.example.com on every boot — good, but ensure any FK/related snapshot cleanup runs (leftover snapshots referencing deleted store_ids could bloat DB).
fetch_policy._penalise using getattr(resp, 'headers', None) or {} is a good hardening; consider adding a unit test that passes a bare exception-like object to lock in the invariant.
seed_data_creation: None. POST /api/stores acceptance test creates a store and immediately deletes it in the same test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter76_review.py — uses one login (module-scoped fixture) to avoid the login rate limiter. Requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var. Notes verified live: /api/stores has exactly 11 stores, no *.example.com; /api/admin/proxy-health returns proxy_enabled=false + tls_impersonation_available=true; ranking endpoint sorted revenue_desc; all 90d insights endpoints return 200.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration was a stability verification; no regressions found. The iter76 fixes (defensive .get in _sales_pairs_from_rollups, example.com hygiene, POST /api/stores 400 validation, proxy-free crawler) are all live and behaving as described in the review request.
